physics-h1-q2.title: Massasi bir xil ikkita
physics-h1-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q2.material: Massasi bir xil ikkita tuxum bir xil balandlikdan mos ravishda sement pol va yumshoq yostiq ustiga tushirildi. Tuxum polga tekkan paytdan to'xtagunga qadar fizik kattaliklarni solishtirish bo'yicha to'g'ri javob qaysi?

physics-h1-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h1-q3.title: Massasi 0,5 kg bo'lgan
physics-h1-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-q3.material: Massasi 0,5 kg bo'lgan beysbol to'pi 30 m/s tezlik bilan uchib kelib, tayoqqa tegib, teskari yo'nalishda 40 m/s tezlik bilan qaytib ketdi. To'pning olgan zarba impulsi miqdori qancha?
physics-h1-q3.s.s1.prompt: Massasi 0,5 kg bo'lgan beysbol to'pi 30 m/s tezlik bilan uchib kelib, tayoqqa tegib, teskari yo'nalishda 40 m/s tezlik bilan qaytib ketdi. To'pning olgan zarba impulsi miqdori qancha?
physics-h1-q3.s.s1.explain: Boshlang'ich harakat miqdori $p_1 = 0.5 \times 30 = +15\text{ kg}\cdot\text{m/s}$, keyingi harakat miqdori $p_2 = 0.5 \times (-40) = -20\text{ kg}\cdot\text{m/s}$. Zarba impulsining miqdori $|\Delta p| = |-20 - 15| = 35\text{ N}\cdot\text{s}$.

physics-h1-q3.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h1-c.title: [Chuqurlashtirilgan mexanika] Balandligi 80
physics-h1-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h1-c.material: [Chuqurlashtirilgan mexanika] Balandligi 80 m bo'lgan jarlik chetidan massasi 1 kg bo'lgan jism gorizontal yo'nalishda 20 m/s tezlik bilan otildi. Bu jism yerga yetib kelguncha gorizontal yo'nalishda qancha masofani bosib o'tadi? (g = 10 m/s², havo qarshiligi e'tiborga olinmasin)
physics-h1-c.s.s1.prompt: [Chuqurlashtirilgan mexanika] Balandligi 80 m bo'lgan jarlik chetidan massasi 1 kg bo'lgan jism gorizontal yo'nalishda 20 m/s tezlik bilan otildi. Bu jism yerga yetib kelguncha gorizontal yo'nalishda qancha masofani bosib o'tadi? (g = 10 m/s², havo qarshiligi e'tiborga olinmasin)
physics-h1-c.s.s1.explain: Vertikal tushish vaqti $80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$ soniya. Gorizontal ko'chish tekis harakat bo'lgani uchun $x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.

physics-killer-10.title: Biror metall plastinkaga monoxromatik
physics-killer-10.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-10.material: Biror metall plastinkaga monoxromatik yorug'lik tushiriladigan fotoeffekt tajribasida ikki chastota uchun fotoelektronlarning maksimal kinetik energiyasi o'lchandi va natija quyidagi jadvaldagidek. Chastota $7.5\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lganda $E_k=1.0\,\mathrm{eV}$, chastota $9.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lganda $E_k=1.6\,\mathrm{eV}$. Plank doimiysi $h=4.0\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{eV\cdot s}$ (masala uchun taxminiy qiymat). Bu metallning chegaraviy chastotasi $\nu_0$ va chastotasi $12.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lgan yorug'lik tushirilgandagi to'xtatuvchi kuchlanish $V_0$ tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?

Chastota $7.5\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lganda $E_k=1.0\,\mathrm{eV}$, chastota $9.0\times10^{14}\,\mathrm{Hz}$ bo'lganda $E_k=1.6\,\mathrm{eV}$.
